01

The mobile hero requests a 42.5 MB animation

The homepage selects a 42.5 MB animated background on mobile; 25.1 MB arrived in 30 seconds and the transfer was still unfinished.

  • Use an approved lightweight static mobile poster or optimized video, and prevent the large animation from loading on the static path.
  • Separately test high priority on the existing section-4-60 background preload; retest the 72/100 mobile benchmark without removing tracking.
02

Two article links lead to a missing page

The cosmetic-cost guide links twice to a missing singular-slug implant article, although the matching plural-slug article is live.

  • Update the body and Related Articles hrefs directly to /blog/dental-implants-pros-and-cons/.
  • Add an exact 301 from /blog/dental-implant-pros-and-cons/ to that verified article; keep both referring links in the repair map.

03

Dentist schema omits Thursday opening hours

The homepage Dentist schema lists Monday–Wednesday but omits Thursday, which the current Google profile shows as 8:00 AM–4:30 PM.

  • Add Thursday 08:00–16:30 to the existing Dentist.openingHoursSpecification; keep the correct Organization, identity and other hours.
  • Trim postalCode from “ 27103” to “27103”; no Product schema exists and no broad removal is needed.
04

The blog stops after seven articles

The visible blog has seven cards and no browsing controls, leaving 15 published guides without a homepage HTML-link path.

  • Add crawlable pagination or approved topic links so visitors can reach the existing guides from /blog/.
  • Add relevant contextual links to those guides; keep educational intent and do not force the hub into search.

Fix order

Reduce the large mobile background, repair the two hrefs, complete Thursday schema hours and restore article browsing.

  • Website: quality-preserving hero policy, exact href/301 pair, existing Dentist field corrections and article navigation.
  • SEO: review the hub’s intentional indexability and continue existing readability/client-assets work; preserve tracking and current booking.

Existing booking, tracked phones and VA/provider work are preserved. Lab speed is not field performance; the huge hero download and smaller LCP background are separate.
